algorithm: candidate_1 is the immutable refs/tags/0.0.4 peeled target 089efbb87746e153e9ee051bf228b9c12aa3889a
candidate_2 is the existing-provenance history-boundary commit a265229cb29688715651cbd831a3b4c10b8f98b4 named fix cube script
fetch only missing exact objects or the exact tag; do not consult mutable branch heads for evidence
select no other commit or version

candidates.basis: latest immutable release before preserved HDF5 mtime
existing strongest direct collector evidence and sealed history boundary

source_lock_normalization.name: packaging.utils.canonicalize_name
source_lock_normalization.markers: canonical marker string emitted by packaging
source_lock_normalization.comparison: sorted canonical requirement tuples with source base compared to lock root requires_dist entries without extra marker and source env compared to entries whose marker activates extra env

eligibility.temporal_rule: commit must predate immutable 2026-03-26 upload; preserved 2026-02-18 HDF5 mtime is supportive only and a post-mtime commit requires explicit caveat

tie_behavior: zero or multiple candidates passing static source-lock, file, collector, and temporal rules => coherent_generator_candidate_not_identified and no install or scientific execution

restore_modes.cold: fresh MjData; inject exact time,qpos,qvel,target mocap,appropriate ctrl; mj_forward then step
restore_modes.reused: reuse prior MjData; overwrite exact time,qpos,qvel,target mocap,appropriate ctrl; mj_forward then step

metrics.control: 5-D normalized action through candidate mapping versus stored 7-D ctrl
metrics.render: EGL causal only if available; otherwise descriptive GLFW excluded

comparison_rules.materially_closer: all designated core maximum errors non-increasing and at least one <= 0.5 of current
comparison_rules.exact_core: observation and control <= respective tolerance and dynamics <= transition tolerance

decision_tree.provenance_limit: never claim exact released generator solely from mechanics match
